intro: You climbed all the way up here. How sweet. Nothing in this tower is for you to see.

lies.text: Every page of the budget is open to every citizen.
lies.reaction: Every page about who proposed what is blacked out.

lies.text: We have never refused a request for information.
lies.reaction: Refused, refused, refused. The same line every time.

lies.text: No record in this building was ever destroyed.
lies.reaction: Four pallets of paper, the night before the audit.

lies.text: Nobody here ever shaped what the public could see.
lies.reaction: Bots to cheer, edits to hide. You decided what they saw.

lies.text: This tower is clean. There is no corruption here.
lies.reaction: Bribes, bought votes and a family payroll. All of it, from every floor.
